```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
orders <- read_csv("data/ec_orders.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
products <- read_csv("data/ec_products.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

m <- ymd("2025-12-01")   # 対象の月

ec <- orders |>
  left_join(products, by = "product_id") |>
  mutate(sales = qty * unit_price,
         ym = floor_date(order_date, unit = "month"))

kpi <- ec |>
  group_by(ym) |>
  summarise(sales = sum(sales),
            buyers = n_distinct(customer_id),
            orders = n_distinct(order_id)) |>
  mutate(spend = sales / buyers)

now <- kpi |> filter(ym == m)
```

## Row {height="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "売上（万円）"
list(icon = "currency-yen", color = "primary", value = round(now$sales / 10000))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "客数（人）"
list(icon = "people", color = "info", value = now$buyers)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "客単価（円）"
list(icon = "cart", color = "secondary", value = round(now$spend))
```

## Row {height="75%"}

```{r}
#| title: "月別の売上（万円）"
ggplot(kpi, aes(x = ym, y = sales / 10000)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| title: "カテゴリ別の売上（対象月、万円）"
ec |>
  filter(ym == m) |>
  group_by(category) |>
  summarise(sales = sum(sales) / 10000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(category, sales), y = sales)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```
